input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
errors: My first re-runs of the ticket-resale mutants passed a test glob to node with its quotes intact (unquoted shell variable), so node ran 0 tests and exited 0; quality_mutate graded every mutant SURVIVED. Caught by comparing with a manual run; tool fixed in this PR.

doc_friction.issue: A baseline that ran zero tests counted as green, so a mistyped test command made every mutant a survivor. Fixed here (refuses '# tests 0' / 'Ran 0 tests').
No documented vocabulary for hypothesis status; I found supported/refuted/untested by grepping 2,500 entries and used 'refuted'.

`sample` skips seeds used by open `quality: round N (seed S)` PRs, but two sessions that draw within minutes of each other both see none and pick the same seed (second time on 2026-11-13: rounds 59 and 62). A claim that lands before drawing (e.g. a branch or a file pushed at draw time, checked again just before opening the PR) would close the race.

deviations.why: PR #15416 (another session) drew the same seed 2026-11-13-h and merged its round-62 audits of the same four subjects while this run was finishing; my claim PR opened at about the same time, so `sample` could not see it.
deviations.did: Followed the round-59 precedent: moved this session's audits to portfolio/quality/blind-pairs/2026-11-13-h/ (outside audits/ so summary counts each subject once), merged main keeping #15416's fixes, added the fixes only this audit's findings called for, and turned the round post into a blind-pair post.
deviations.result: Second blind inter-rater sample: 23/28 scores identical, 28/28 within one, 4/4 verdicts; pooled with round 59, 44/56 (Wilson 66%-87%). The PDF-by-URL hold bypass and the unquoted-comma ROI bug were found only by this audit.

notes: Seed 2026-11-13-h, round 62, mode sample. Subjects: ventures/llm-spend-guard, ventures/ticket-resale-profit-calculator, research/simdesign-fwdcheck, research/categorical-scores (no flagship/platform eligible). Spot-checks I ran myself: ticket-resale comma row (cost 1, ROI 19800%), break-even 137.22 by hand, PDF-by-URL estimate 59 tokens, fwdcheck nominal stress 162.8 MPa by hand, categorical E4 log 0.151 and Brier rho^2 K/(K-1) by hand, original ticket suite passes the salvage mutant (31/31). Mutants killed after the fixes (quality_mutate rows): ticket engine.mjs:77, :60, :191 caught; categorical model.py:49, :33, :29 caught; llm-spend-guard proxy.mjs:183 (complete ? usage : null) caught, new n>1 guard mutant caught; simdesign check.py:32 shear 3->1 caught. Still surviving: llm-spend-guard bytes/3 ratio (guard.mjs:173); simdesign load sign, clamp exclusion, deflection mean (FE solves too slow for quick tests). Local checks: node suites 47/47 and 35/35, run_venture_tests ok, categorical unittest 8 OK, fwdcheck fast tests 4 passed, test_quality_mutate 12 OK, quality_audit validate 302/0, research homepage build ok, check_md_links ok, post front matter/links ok. After merging main: llm-spend-guard 48/48, ticket-resale 39/39, categorical OK, simdesign fast tests 4 passed, homepage build ok, md links ok, versions --check current, validate 302/0. Blind pair agreement 23/28 exact, 28/28 within one, 4/4 verdict; second audit higher on all 5 disagreements (round 59 pair: lower on all 7).

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: four independent expert audits (~3 h each incl. FE re-runs and derivations) plus fixes and write-up

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
